int_name: OLD YORK RD & RISING SUN AVE

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and traffic signals, but pedestrians must cross a wide roadway with embedded streetcar tracks. The environment is characterized by long crossing distances and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles near the corners.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded metal tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slip/fall hazard for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Running longitudinally through the center of the roadway and across the intersection.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the street increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicular traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: The main crossing across the street with tracks.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, parked car near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk across the side street. However, the environment is degraded by sidewalk obstructions, a lack of visible pedestrian signals, and parked vehicles that limit sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large bags or debris are piled on the sidewalk at the corner, obstructing the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner near the utility pole

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are situated immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, obscuring pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street crossing

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks visible pedestrian signal heads to provide safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers at all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility between motorists and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and sidewalks on both sides. However, the presence of embedded trolley tracks and a relatively wide crossing distance without a median refuge increases exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks embedded in the asphalt can be slippery when wet and pose a tripping hazard for pedestrians or a trapping hazard for bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Running longitudinally through the center of the roadway and across the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a mid-point refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: The main roadway crossing in the foreground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban intersection with industrial land use and significant crossing distances. While sidewalks and overhead traffic signals are present, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian safety enhancements like refuge islands or high-visibility markings at all crossing points.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Surface hazards
hazards.description: Visible rails or metal grates in the roadway can be slippery or cause tripping hazards for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to break up the long crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental or zebra-style markings to all legs of the intersection to increase driver awareness.
